title: Saving New Customer on a term deactivated meanwhile is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You and a second user, {User-B}, are both signed in with the "Admin" role, in two separate browsers.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-24 Second Admin.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-24 Fourteen.
  • A name for the new customer, {Customer-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-24 Customer.
  • Starting screen: your browser shows the Customers page; {User-B}'s browser shows the Credit Terms page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Type {Customer-A} in Customer Name.
  3. Choose {Term-A} in Credit Terms.
  4. In {User-B}'s browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  5. In {User-B}'s browser, click "Deactivate".
  6. In your browser, click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Customer" window opens.
  • Step 2: the field shows the name as typed.
  • Step 3: the dropdown shows {Term-A}.
  • Step 4: the menu opens.
  • Step 5: {User-B} sees "{Term-A} deactivated".
  • Step 6: the app's error alert shows "Pick an active credit term." The New Customer window stays open and the customer is not created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • Story 5, Error Handling: “If the chosen term was deactivated or deleted after the form opened, Save on New Customer is refused and the app's standard error alert shows "Pick an active credit term." The form stays open.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “New Customer term no longer active (server) | "Pick an active credit term." | Standard error alert, form stays open”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "5 New Customer", "6 Customer on a deactivated term" (the pages the PRD names for this story).
